answer: Locks are written down in grove, expire in ferrous, and walnut lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 14 aliases therefore needs 108 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 6 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
